Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Latin brevem. Compare Occitan brèu.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic, Valencia) [ˈbɾew]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Adjective

[edit]

breu m or f (masculine and feminine plural breus)

  1. short
  2. brief

Derived terms

[edit]
  • breument
  • en breu

Related terms

[edit]
  • abreujar
  • brevetat

Noun

[edit]

breu m (plural breus)

  1. (orthography) breve
  2. sigil

Derived terms

[edit]
  • breu pontifici

Further reading

[edit]
  • “breu”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “breu”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “breu” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “breu” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From a Celtic language. Compare Spanish brea.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbɾɛw/

Noun

[edit]

breu m (plural breus)

  1. tar, pitch
  2. mud hardened by frost
  3. fog, mist

Synonyms

[edit]
  • brea, alcatrén, piche, recina, cerne

Middle English

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

breu

  1. alternative form of brewe

Old Occitan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin brevem, accusative singular of brevis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /bɾɛw/

Adjective

[edit]

breu

  1. short

Descendants

[edit]
  • Occitan: brèu

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From French brai (“pitch”). Compare Spanish brea.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈbɾew/ [ˈbɾeʊ̯]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈbɾew/

  • Rhymes: -ew

Noun

[edit]

breu m (plural breus)

  1. tar, pitch
    Synonyms: piche, pez
  2. (figuratively) darkness (lack of light)
    Synonyms: escuro, escuridão
    estar um breu ― to be very dark

Further reading

[edit]
  • “breu”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “breu”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
  • “breu”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “breu”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026
